_readme: install.ps1 fills 'base' and 'odoo' automatically. Edit 'owner', 'team', and 'projects', then run /engram-drive setup.
_base_note: Filled automatically by install.ps1 — points to My Drive/Engram/engram-sync/ on your Google Drive. Change only if you want a different folder structure.

odoo._note: Filled automatically by install.ps1. odoo_version and community_path are detected from your existing projects. Leave enterprise_path empty for Community-only setups.
